doc_summary: `native_compute_fog_color(partial, camera, fog_type, rgb)` adjusts the final world fog RGB after normal biome, weather and effect calculation and before GPU upload. Camera is its world position; fog_type distinguishes atmosphere, water, lava and powder snow. Only finite components in 0..=1 are accepted; invalid requests retain the original RGB. Alpha and all distance fields are unchanged. Title panoramas skip this hook. Bundles need "hooks": @API:compute_fog_color@.
